content: rapidfuzz fuzz.ratio is normalized Indel similarity on a 0-100 float scale: 1 - distance/(len1+len2); it differs from difflib SequenceMatcher.ratio (matching-blocks, 0-1). process.extract(query, choices, scorer=fuzz.ratio, limit=n, score_cutoff=75) returns (choice, score, index) tuples best-first; ties break by choice index; cutoff keeps scores >= the threshold; default scorer is WRatio so fuzz.ratio must be passed explicitly. Local measurement on rapidfuzz 3.14.5: 73k-term list ~1.7-1.9 ms/query, vs difflib full-vocab ~51 ms and current first-letter bucket ~5.9 ms; curated difflib-vs-Indel pairs agree on 0.75/75 membership including resturant->restaur exactly 75.0.
